settings.new_controls.description: Expose Guard and Substitution as independent remappable actions and own the default shoulder-button layout for both players.

allow_substitution_while_guard_is_held.description: Bypass the native 16-frame held-Guard rejection before the independent Substitution input search.

default_battle_overlay_bindings.description: Initialize the battle overlay with Substitution on L1, Guard on R1, Item Select on L2, and Linked Attack on R2.

default_control_settings_reset_selection.description: Make the Control Settings Select-button reset assign Substitution to L1, Guard to R1, Item Select to L2, and Linked Attack to R2 for either player.

default_resident_bindings.description: Reset every resident controller bank to Substitution on L1, Guard on R1, Item Select on L2, and Linked Attack on R2.

include_substitution_in_shoulder_assignm.description: Extend the Control Settings shoulder-action selector through action index 7 so Substitution can be chosen independently.

preserve_substitution_when_opening_assig.description: Stop the native editor from rewriting action index 7 to Guard index 6 when its assignment selector opens.

remove_substitution_action_from_logical_.description: Remove action-map index 7 from the held Guard translation while preserving index 6 as the sole source of the logical block bit.

search_substitution_action_in_first_inpu.description: Search configured action-map index 7 instead of Guard at index 6, matching the predicate's unchanged second arm.

label_substitution_action.description: Point Control Settings action-map index 7 at the resident Substitution label instead of the second Guard label.

replace_paired_action_assignment.description: Replace the native Guard-pair assignment helper with an owned one-action swap so Guard, Substitution, Item Select, and Linked Attack remain independently assignable.

settings.simple_display.description: Choose the native battle Simple Display default.

settings.character_overrides.description: Select per-character battle values from the generated character-override table.

select_cost_for_live_fighter.description: Replace the native cost transfer and delay slot with a guarded call that passes the live fighter while preserving the following subtraction and clamp.

settings.battle_mechanics.chakra.description: Share one selectable Chakra behavior between Battle Settings and Practice Settings.

settings.battle_mechanics.xdash_chakra_c.description: Spend the configured chakra cost on the first fighter update after X-dash becomes non-cancellable.

settings.ingame.description: Apply independent configured native defaults to Battle and Practice manager state.

update_shared_fighter_settings.description: Preserve the native per-fighter update while applying shared X-dash charging before it and the selected Chakra behavior after it.

native_defaults_apply_battle_defaults_wh.description: Preserve the mode-2 manager assignment, apply the configured Battle default pack, and rejoin the native mode-selection flow.

native_defaults_apply_mode_defaults_afte.description: Preserve the native Strength mirror write, then apply the configured default pack for the active Battle or Practice mode.

battle_initialize_active_rows_on_open.description: Run the native settings snapshot, activate the Battle root page, resolve its row resources, and stage every battle mechanic selector.

battle_release_submenu_style_resources.description: Release the Practice child-page style resources before the native Battle controller free.

battle_confirm_active_row.description: Commit every staged battle mechanic selector and close from every row, including submenu launchers, before the native settings transaction stores its own rows.

battle_handle_page_cancel.description: Return from the Battle Battle Mechanics page or retain the native root-page cancel behavior.

battle_reset_active_modes_to_configured_.description: Stage every configured native and battle mechanic default alongside the native Select reset.

battle_navigate_active_rows.description: Wrap navigation over the active Battle page count.

battle_change_active_row_value.description: Open a submenu launcher on Square or change the selected mapped native value or staged battle mechanic selector within its semantic bound.

battle_route_ultimate_jutsu_value_help.description: Run the native value-specific Ultimate Jutsu help only for the semantic Ultimate Jutsu row, using Command help for the two custom contest modes.

battle_load_active_help_table_high.description: Point the native help refresh at the resolved active help table.

battle_load_active_label_table_high.description: Point the native label loop at the resolved active label table.

battle_draw_visible_label_rows.description: Draw the active Battle page's current visible label count.

battle_route_visible_time_draw.description: Use the native Time renderer only when the visible slot contains the semantic Time row.

battle_route_visible_handicap_draw.description: Use the native Handicap renderer only for the visible semantic Handicap row.

battle_position_visible_handicap_red_val.description: Move the native red Handicap value graphics to the active visible row.

battle_position_visible_handicap_blue_va.description: Move the native blue Handicap value graphics to the active visible row.

battle_draw_active_value.description: Load an ordinary visible row through its mapped native slot or staged custom mode.

battle_draw_visible_value_rows.description: Draw the active Battle page's current visible value count.

battle_resolve_helper_maximum.description: Give the native arrow helper the selected visible row's semantic maximum.

battle_resolve_helper_value.description: Give the native arrow helper the selected visible row's mapped value.

battle_route_native_handicap_arrows.description: Use the native Handicap arrows only for the visible semantic Handicap row.

battle_select_page_appropriate_cursor.description: Use the native Handicap cursor object only for the visible semantic Handicap row.

battle_draw_page_backing.description: Compose the exact active row backing and position the native Handicap panel at its visible slot.

battle_draw_visible_rows.description: Update the logical scroll window, remap its visible rows, and draw them through the native table footprint.

battle_draw_visible_cursor.description: Draw the native cursor and arrows at the selected row's visible slot while retaining the logical selection.

practice_confirm_active_row.description: Apply the complete Practice transaction and close from every row, including submenu launchers.

practice_handle_page_cancel.description: Return from a Practice submenu or retain the native root-page cancel behavior.

practice_bypass_fixed_special_row_help.description: Skip the obsolete fixed-index Health, Ultimate Jutsu, and Status help refresh after a value change; the schema-driven refresh later in the same update owns it.

practice_change_active_row_value.description: Open a submenu launcher on Square or change the selected active-page row through its mapped native controller slot or custom staged value within its schema-defined bound.

practice_draw_active_value.description: Load the selected compact-table value while preserving the native value table, color, localized value adapter, and row position.

practice_draw_dynamic_cursor_geometry.description: Place the cursor from section-local visible geometry and native backing roles instead of fixed global row indices.

practice_draw_dynamic_row_count.description: Loop over the active page count rather than the native constant 17.

practice_draw_dynamic_section_boundary.description: Draw the native Opponent Settings heading at the active page's player-to-opponent boundary.

practice_load_active_page_heading.description: Load the active child page's title for the native orange Practice section heading while preserving its native text style.

practice_draw_compact_backing.description: Draw count-derived first, middle, and terminal backing cells for both sections, repeating native middle cells beyond the animation's fixed capacities.

practice_initialize_active_rows_on_open.description: Run the native snapshot, activate the root page, resolve its localized resources, and stage every battle mechanic selector.

practice_initialize_active_row_help.description: Clear the native Practice help object, then show help for the generated root page's selected row.

practice_navigate_active_rows.description: Wrap navigation over the active page count instead of the native constant 17.

practice_prepare_compact_backing_layout.description: After native animation advance and before hierarchy composition, assign first, middle, and terminal backing roles from each section's actual row count and place the Opponent heading at the resulting boundary.

practice_reset_active_rows_to_defaults.description: Run native Defaults, apply the configured defaults to every retained or shared row, and preserve the native reset message.

practice_resolve_helper_maximum.description: Give the native arrow helper the selected schema row's dynamic maximum.

practice_resolve_helper_value.description: Give the native arrow helper the selected schema row's active value.

practice_route_row_availability.description: Evaluate enabled and grey states by semantic row behavior rather than fixed display indices.

practice_update_dynamic_scroll_flags.description: Derive upper and lower scroll indicators from each compact section's actual count.

practice_update_dynamic_windows.description: Update the two native animated row windows from the compact player and opponent counts and their dynamic boundary.

practice_update_schema_help.description: Resolve running help from the selected semantic row, including every custom selector explanation.

practice_update_selected_row_section.description: Keep the native selected-row arrow Y calculation but compare against the compact player-section count.

settings.battle_mechanics.items.description: Shared Items presets and a configurable weighted Custom item pool.

choose_custom_field_item_0.description: Filter the native field-item distribution through the shared Custom selection.

choose_custom_field_item_1.description: Filter the native field-item distribution through the shared Custom selection.

choose_custom_field_item_2.description: Filter the native field-item distribution through the shared Custom selection.

choose_custom_field_item_3.description: Filter the native field-item distribution through the shared Custom selection.

spawn_selected_field_item_0.description: Skip the complete spawn request when Custom has no enabled outcome in this distribution.

spawn_selected_field_item_1.description: Skip the complete spawn request when Custom has no enabled outcome in this distribution.

spawn_selected_field_item_2.description: Skip the complete spawn request when Custom has no enabled outcome in this distribution.

spawn_selected_field_item_3.description: Skip the complete spawn request when Custom has no enabled outcome in this distribution.

shared_items_amount.description: Resolve the shared Items selection for the native amount branches.

custom_small_chakra_pickups.description: Apply the Chakra Ball choice to the small chakra pickups emitted by native amount handling.

settings.battle_mechanics.sub_active_fra.description: Select vanilla attack timing or a total pre-impact input window of 1 through 15 frames while preserving resource, response, state, and attack-block gates.

select_substitution_active_history.description: Resume native random and clamped timing for Default, or convert the selected total window to prior-history frames and rejoin the guard-age and history checks.

settings.battle_mechanics.substitution.description: Own ordinary substitution resource routing across selectable Chakra, Gauge, and Free modes; charge Gauge from the character override's normalized substitution cost, recover it on the native battle clock and committed HP loss, and draw its independent textured top-HUD bar without modifying the native support renderer.

adjust_battle_hud_character_name_y.description: Add the gauge-only vertical offset after the native renderer has resolved the Battle HUD character-name Y anchor, then retain its scale multiplication and side load.

gate_ordinary_substitution_with_stock.description: Route the native resource comparison through the selected Chakra, Gauge, or Free predicate, then rejoin the unchanged normalized acceptance branch.

spend_stock_without_chakra.description: After native charged-transition setup, retain the complete native chakra path in Chakra mode, spend the resolved gauge cost in Gauge mode, or spend nothing in Free mode.

restart_delay_after_every_success.description: Restart recovery after charged and deliberately free substitution transitions, then call the displaced native success helper once and preserve its return value.

sample_committed_fighter_hp.description: Sample normalized HP once on the shared active-fighter path, then call the adjacent displaced native update exactly once without overlapping the X-dash hook.

advance_on_native_battle_clock.description: Advance both slots once per native 30-FPS update when scheduler and terminal flags permit, then retain the displaced countdown call and return value.

reset_on_new_battle_construction.description: Initialize both manager-owned slots after the two fighter pointers are published in the one-time battle-graph construction branch, then retain the displaced native call.

cache_substitution_gauge_render_source.description: Retain the native support-controller update, then cache its initialized per-side sprite and BTL rendering context without drawing through the support-controller lifecycle.

draw_independent_substitution_gauge_with.description: Retain the primary per-side Battle HUD draw, then draw the independent substitution bar only after the native parent visibility gate accepts that HUD side, using the same live layout transform and primary-sprite alpha.

settings.battle_mechanics.ultimate_jutsu.description: Back the shared Ultimate Jutsu selector with runtime state and guarded contest and HUD behavior.

gate_contest_press_latch.description: Read the native contest press state for native modes and return zero for No Contest and No HUD.

gate_contest_release_poll.description: Read the native contest release state for native modes and return zero for No Contest and No HUD.

gate_contest_render.description: Retain the contest object's lifecycle and render dispatch for native modes while suppressing its meter, prompts, and results for No Contest and No HUD.

transition_complete_battle_hud_during_co.description: For No HUD only, observe the retained contest lifecycle and request the same all-HUD hide/show transition APIs used by ordinary jutsu.

settings.battle_mechanics.shadowblur.description: Back the shared Shadowblur Extra Hit selector with independent runtime state and its guarded native branch.

select_shadowblur_extra_hit_path.description: Preserve the native predicate result while choosing whether the Shadowblur Extra Hit side-effect path runs.

settings.battle_mechanics.extra_hit.description: Shared Extra Hit selection with native rejection recovery and a once-per-attack chakra penalty.

check_extra_hit.description: Apply the selector after native eligibility; rejection keeps native action-exit handling.

begin_extra_hit_attack.description: Reset initiation charging at the native generic-attack initializer.

settings.battle_mechanics.support.description: Shared Off, Nerfed, Normal, and Unlimited support in Battle and Practice.

route_free_field_support_call.description: Route manual support input and Nerfed summon-to-attack transition.

route_support_gauge_draw.description: Suppress the dedicated native support gauge only while Off.

remove_practice_link_gauge_refill.description: Remove the separate Practice General Link Gauge refill; shared Support owns Unlimited.
